+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Bug: 6 nested-run tests hung in two full runs, with no known cause'
+---
+## Facts
+
+Two full runs hung on Router e2688ac2:
+- `base.log`: the task 45 sources were stashed;
+- `full2.log`: with the task 45 sources.
+
+Each of these tests has a "started" line and no end line in both logs:
+- AgentSchedulingTests `checkWithNoIDListsOnlyRunsOfCaller`
+- CheckAgentProgressTests `answerToMailGivesProgress` (`base.log` only; it passed in `full2.log` after 1.904 s)
+- NestedRunTests+Idle `answerToMailThatStartsChildWaitsForIt`
+- AgentsDemoProfileModeTests `chatModeWritesTheAnswerToTheMail` and `chatModeCancelsOpenRunsBeforeClose`
+- TelemetryContentSafetyTests `messagesCarryNoContent`
+
+The paused-mail tests also hung in these runs. Their cause is known (cause 1): an answer to mail alone counts toward `mailOnlyAnswerLimit` only when it starts a new background run. Commit b763e82 corrects these tests with `pausedLimit = 0`.
+
+The hung runs have these facts:
+- Each log has all 1001 test starts. Thus no test waited for a parallel slot.
+- The `sample` output of the hung test process shows no blocked thread. The main thread is in `swift_task_asyncMainDrainQueue`, and each other thread is an idle worker. There is no ulock, mutex, condition or semaphore wait. Thus an async continuation does not resume.
+- The disk was full or almost full at about the time of the hung runs.
+
+After that time, three runs did not hang. All three used Router e2688ac2, Extras 016c5a8 and limit 100 for the 6 tests:
+- one log run of `checkWithNoIDListsOnlyRunsOfCaller` (0.116 s);
+- two full runs (530/530).
+
+## Refuted causes
+
+- Extras 11b7c7e..016c5a8: the only change makes `holdingRunToken` public. It does not change behavior.
+- The limit: line 147 of NestedRunTests+Messages.swift is the default, 100, and it did not change.
+- Tests that wait behind other tests: the tests have no `.serialized` and no global actor. Each test makes a new Router (ScriptedProfile.swift:53) and its own `GenerationQueue` (ScriptedSessionBackend.swift:137).
+- A disk write error: each write path catches the error, logs it and drops the data, or fails in setup:
+  - the Router journal chain does not throw (OperationEventSink.swift:8; JSONLAppend.swift:109-118);
+  - the sidecar catches the error (SessionSidecar.swift:360-368);
+  - a RecordingRootLock ENOSPC drops the event (Sinks.swift:148-156);
+  - Agents and the Extras run plane write no files.
+
+## Do these steps when the hang occurs again
+
+1. Take `sample <pid>` of your own test process before you stop it.
+2. Add log points at these locations:
+   1. StartedRuns `open`, `add`, `close` and `waitForStarts`.
+   2. Each step of `AgentRun.drive`.
+   3. The `runPlane.start` result in Extras BackgroundToolRunner.swift (about line 144).
+   4. After the last `.answered` of the parent: the guard in `acceptedMessagesIfIdle` that fails (AgentRun+Drive.swift:540-557).
+   5. The last session event of the parent, and the feed that sent it.
+   6. The `takeNextBatch` result and `runTokens` at Router RoutedSessionActorPump.swift:152 and :162.
+
+## In-memory waiters to read first
+
+- `StartedRuns.waitForStart` and `openCalls` (StartedRuns.swift:128-143)
+- `ScriptedGate.waitForArrival` and `waitForCancel` (ScriptedGate.swift:130, :142)
+- `ScriptedAgentModel.waitForPrompt` (ScriptedAgentModel.swift:163)
+- The reader-driven `input.finish()` in AgentsDemoProfileModeTests.swift:82-112. It does not end if the expected line does not come.
+- Router lead ^x2aawec: when `openAnswerMail.isSilenced`, Router a21c1cf9/50d8ab0e/53a7b8b9 sends run events and tool close records to the session-wide feed. The parent makes a new idle check only on some events (AgentRun+Drive.swift:419-422), thus an event on the other feed can stop the run with no new check.
+
+#bug
\ No newline at end of file

 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m52bkdvdrpxx2c7x6hg0ns4r
+  text: |-
+    ### Router code read (foundationmodelsrouter-54), 2026-10-16: no race found
+
+    The Router session found no race. It read the code only, with no build.
+
+    **Refuted:**
+    - The lead ^x2aawec (`isSilenced`): `OpenAnswerMail.silence()` has one caller, `endRunningAnswerAtOnce` (RoutedSessionActorDrain.swift:116). That caller runs only from `cancelAll()` or `close()` through `performCancelAll`, and only with delivered mail. `removeAll()` clears the state at each answer end (RoutedSessionActorCancellation.swift:44-49). Each session has its own `OpenAnswerMail`.
+    - The output hub: the feeds have no limit, and `awaitTerminal` checks and registers in one lock step (SessionOutputHub.swift:184-203, 555-571).
+    - `ChangeSignal`: it checks and registers in one lock step.
+    - `RunPlane.wait`: `addWaiter` checks again whether the run is open, and `settle` resumes each waiter (Extras RunPlaneActor.swift:373-390, 857-859, 919-921).
+    - The pump wake: `pumpWakeRequested` gives one more cycle.
+    - The mail-only count at limit 100: the child is open at both reads, thus no pause.
+    - `ParentSessionWatch`: it uses sets, thus the order of events does not matter.
+
+    **Not fully read (possible locations of the cause):**
+    - RoutedSessionActorWorkEvents.swift.
+    - The sequence `close()` → `runDrain` → `sweepBackgroundRuns` → `joinRunBodies` (Drain.swift:213-216). On a cancel, this wait has no end (RunPlaneActor.swift:805-809). A body ends only after `settleByItself` awaits `deliver(settledTerminal:)` on the session (:897-899). The Extras cancel and sweep now also await the posts that end the questions.
+    - Not proven: when a child ends inside the settle period and the call answers inline, `end(in:)` sets `child.state` (AgentRun.swift:803-805) before `runSettled`.
+
+    **Proposal (no decision yet):** keep log points that cost nothing when no hang occurs:
+    - after each await of the parent drive and the child drive (`cancelOpenRuns`, `waitForSettlement`, `session.close()`, `await following`; AgentRun+Drive.swift:105-110);
+    - at the event of the last idle check, and at the guard that fails (:540-557).
+
+    The Router session can also add log lines after each await in `runDrain` (Drain.swift:213-226).
+  timestamp: 2026-10-16T12:39:44.237920+00:00
